title: Thinking on Signaling & Being In-Group
summary: Kahran and Divya pick at how we signal belonging — to alumni networks, queer communities, prospective buyers — and how the same signal (a luxury bag, a beautifully written email) reads differently to different receivers. They notice that opulence used to be a single dialect and now plays loose with quality, cost and flashiness as separable signals.

intents.display: to think about how we signal belonging and read others' signals
